title: Equality and hoisting
prompt: Type exactly what this program prints.

code.javascript:
console.log(0 == '', 0 === '')
console.log(null == undefined, null === undefined)
console.log(NaN == NaN, [1] == 1)
console.log(typeof hoisted, typeof notHoisted)
function hoisted() {}
var notHoisted = function () {}
console.log(typeof notHoisted)

hints: `==` converts types before comparing; `===` never does.
Function declarations are hoisted with their body; `var` is hoisted without its value.
